title: Brain Registry v2
description: Central configuration file for an LSP Brain. Source truth: hand-maintained, committed to version control. Defines domains, scoring, governance, and intelligence configuration.

schema_version.description: Registry schema version. v2.1 (2026-04-28) is additive over v2: introduces the optional `children.*.read_only` boolean for codifying observed-only sibling-peer posture (v3.1 E-V31-B). Registries declaring '2' continue to validate; '2.1' opts into v2.1 awareness.

tools.description: Registered tool definitions. May be empty.

data_sources.description: Registered data source definitions. May be empty.

domain_weights.description: Domain key -> weight (0.0-1.0). Weights of scored domains MUST sum to 1.0 (+/- 0.01). Advisory domains use weight 0.0.

advisory_domains.description: Domain keys with weight 0.0. Excluded from unified score.

type.description: 'cmdb' reads score from a JSON file. 'function' dispatches to implementation-specific scoring functions. 'a2a' fetches the score from a peer Brain A2A endpoint at score time (spec §9 fractal composition — parent pulls child's current AgentOutput via snapshot.requested and uses its top-level score for this domain).

path.description: Path to the CMDB file, relative to project root. Required for type 'cmdb'.

endpoint.description: Peer Brain A2A base URL (e.g., 'http://127.0.0.1:8421/a2a/v1/'). Required for type 'a2a'. The parent Brain will POST snapshot.requested to this endpoint each time the domain is scored; the child's returned AgentOutput.score becomes this domain's raw score.

interface_version.description: Expected agent-output schema version the A2A peer emits. Default: '1'. Used for pre-flight version negotiation (spec §6).

score_field.description: JSON field name containing the score. Default: 'score'.

updated_at_field.description: JSON field name containing the timestamp. Default: 'updated_at'.

no_file_score.description: Score to use when the CMDB file is missing OR the A2A peer is unreachable. Default: 0.

floor.description: Domain floor constraint. If score drops below min_score, the unified score is capped.

min_score.description: Threshold below which the floor activates.

unified_cap.description: Maximum unified score when floor is active.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of why the floor exists.

exported_variables.description: Variables extracted from CMDB data for cross-domain correlation.

calibration_trigger.description: Optional. Opts the domain into automated calibration-ledger entries (spec §17.3). Discriminated union by `kind`. Auto-fire requires this field set to a non-`Manual` variant AND the registry's `enable_calibration_writes` set to `true`. The `domain-calibration` domain itself MUST use `Manual` (recursion guard, spec §17.9). New domains default to `Manual` until their score distribution and signal taxonomy are observed.

oneOf.description: Threshold-driven: the Brain appends a `pending` entry when `effective_score < min` OR `effective_score > max`. Operators SHOULD configure this only after observing the domain's score distribution.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound; effective_score < this triggers.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound; effective_score > this triggers.

oneOf.description: Event-driven: the Brain appends a `pending` entry when the domain emits a CMDB finding whose name matches one of `signal_kinds`, or when an extras-key matches.
No automated triggers — entries are operator-created via `neurogrim domain-calibration triage --manual`. Default for new domains.
DEFERRED to v2 of the trigger union. Δ-from-rolling-baseline using §7 trajectory primitive. Reserved variant so future configs round-trip cleanly through v1 readers.

domain_variables.description: Static domain variables (hand-configured). Merged with auto-extracted variables at runtime.

enable_calibration_writes.description: Global gate for the domain-calibration ledger writer (spec §17.3). When `false` (default), the Brain emits NO automated calibration-ledger entries regardless of any per-domain `calibration_trigger` setting. When `true`, per-domain auto-fire requires a non-`Manual` `calibration_trigger` on the domain's definition. Manual operator triage via `neurogrim domain-calibration triage` is unaffected by this flag (the CLI writer always works). Both opt-ins must be set for an entry to be auto-created at score time.

model.description: 'multiplier': effective = raw * confidence / 100. 'floor': effective = min(raw, ceiling) when confidence < threshold.

floor_confidence_threshold.description: For 'floor' model: confidence below this triggers the ceiling.

floor_score_ceiling.description: For 'floor' model: max effective score when confidence is below threshold.

gate_tiers.description: Gate tier definitions with scoring and priority weights.

cmdb_fresh_days.description: Age in days below which CMDB data is considered fresh.

cmdb_stale_days.description: Age in days at which CMDB data is considered stale.

cmdb_very_stale_days.description: Age in days at which CMDB data is considered very stale. Used as the half-life anchor for exponential decay: confidence = 25 at this age.

attention_budget.description: Limits on recommendation output to prevent overload.

action_types.description: Action type definitions with default autonomy level.

safety_invariants.description: Safety rules that can only tighten autonomy, never loosen.

human_personas.description: Human user persona definitions for output filtering (executive, manager, developer, etc.). Renamed from `personas` 2026-04-19 to distinguish from the agent-hat concept.

incident_patterns.description: Incident pattern definitions for multi-signal detection.

sensory_servers.description: MCP sensory server configurations (v2). The Brain discovers and invokes these via MCP protocol. See spec Section 3.7 + Appendix F. MCP is the sensory contract; A2A is the peer-Brain contract (see 'children' and 'dual_brain').

command.description: Binary or script to spawn (for stdio transport).

children.description: Fractal composition child Brain registrations (spec Section 9). Each entry selects a transport: 'a2a_endpoint' set -> A2A (RECOMMENDED v2.1+); 'brain_path' only -> subprocess (legacy, conformant). MCP is NOT used for child invocation — see 'sensory_servers' for MCP.

brain_path.description: Path to child Brain entry point for subprocess transport (legacy).

a2a_endpoint.description: Base URL of child Brain A2A server. Presence selects A2A transport. RECOMMENDED for v2.1+.

agent_card_url.description: Optional override for child Agent Card location. Default: {a2a_endpoint}/.well-known/agent-card.json.

read_only.description: v2.1+. When true, declares this child as observed-only: the parent Brain reads scores via snapshot.requested but MUST NOT originate outbound writes (e.g., config.changed) toward this child. Codifies the ecosystem's non-influencing posture for sibling-project peers brought into the topology as observables (v3.1 E-V31-B). Schema-level documentation of intent; runtime enforcement at the A2A client envelope-construction layer is a separate piece (v3.1 E-V31-B implementation). Defaults to false for backward compatibility — pre-v2.1 registries and ecosystem-internal children behave unchanged.

dual_brain.description: Dual brain configuration (Stage 6). Ignored by local-only brains. In v2.1+, inter-brain communication uses A2A (see spec Section 10.4 + Appendix G); legacy shared-file event transport is permitted as a degraded mode.

peer_endpoint.description: A2A base URL of the peer Brain. v2.1+ RECOMMENDED path.

peer_agent_card_url.description: Optional override for peer Agent Card location.

shared_state.description: Shared-state file configuration (persists across v2.1 A2A adoption; state is orthogonal to messaging).

event_transport.description: Transport for dual-brain events. v2.1+ RECOMMENDED: A2A. Legacy: shared file (event-log.jsonl).

mode.description: 'a2a' uses Agent2Agent protocol (RECOMMENDED). 'shared_file' is the legacy degraded-mode transport.
